prediction: Scaling the selected head by one should preserve the objective within the declared dtype tolerance. Scaling by one half or zero may alter continuation likelihood; no effect direction is assumed and a likelihood shift is not evidence of correct tool selection or argument execution.

limits: Teacher forcing scores the supplied string; it does not demonstrate generated tool choice, argument correctness, JSON validity of free generation or successful execution.
